data.body: Review-bot outage evidence from agama/change 2801: PS2 (603caf0a7051df71a8537fba33067aa9007f1684) was uploaded 2026-09-07 23:19:09Z, CI started 23:19:18Z, Verified+1 landed 23:46:07Z, and a documented rerun-llm-review trigger was posted at 2026-09-08 00:00:18Z. I then polled change 2801 with bounded 5-minute waits for roughly 40 minutes; LLM-Review stayed neutral (review bot value 0), unresolved_comment_count stayed 0, and Verified remained +1. Cross-checking Gerrit for project:rebar after 2026-09-08 00:00:00 returned recent changes 2802, 2807, and 2801, with zero rebar review bot nonzero LLM-Review votes/messages in that window. This matches the suspected silent review-bot outage shape.
